{"body": "## When to use
Any task: implement one function from a description, no tests given. Load this, then write a checklist of THIS task's requirements before coding.

## Build the checklist
Read the description and examples; extract only what they pin down:
- Signature/imports: keep exactly as given; don't add/remove params or reorder.
- Return type & shape: scalar, tuple order, DataFrame columns/index names, Axes vs Figure, list vs generator. Quote exact names.
- Exceptions: only those named, raised in the stated condition, in the stated order (e.g. missing file before empty file). Use the exact class; don't substitute.
- Edge cases explicitly mentioned (empty input, <2 items, single cluster, defaults). Note the stated return for each.
- Formats shown in examples: print layout, dtypes, rounding, string casing.
- Side effects: files created, plots drawn, processes started; note what must exist afterward.
- Defaults: default args and module constants must be honored.
Write 5-10 numbered items, each checkable by a command. Keep it in your message, not a file.

## Check it
For each item write a tiny script in /tmp (not the repo) that calls the function and asserts the item:
- `type(...)`, `isinstance`, `len`, `list(df.columns)`, `df.index.tolist()`, tuple unpacking order.
- Exceptions: `try/except` and assert the exact class and that it fires for the named trigger; also assert it does NOT fire for valid input.
- Edge cases: pass the empty/short inputs and compare to the stated result.
- Side effects: list the target dir or check `os.path.exists` after the call.
- Plots: assert the returned object is an `Axes`; call `plt.close('all')` between runs.
Run with `python /tmp/check.py`; fix failures, rerun. Also run the module import once to catch syntax/import errors.

## Pitfalls
- Don't invent exceptions or validation the description didn't name.
- Don't change the signature or drop given imports/constants.
- Match column/index labels and tuple order exactly; tests often compare them.
- Respect stated defaults; don't hardcode example values.
- Close figures and clean temp files so repeated calls don't interfere.
- If behavior is ambiguous, pick the reading most consistent with the examples and note it.", "reason": "Shortened to fit under 2000 chars while keeping procedure, conditional rules, and checkable steps."}
